P10.label: video
P10.description: relevant video; use property P18 for images; for film trailers, qualify with "object has role" (P3831)="trailer" (Q622550); for films, qualify with "object has role" (P3831)="full video available on Wikimedia Commons" (Q89347362)

P17.label: country
P17.description: sovereign state that this subject item is in (not to be used for human beings)

P18.label: image
P18.description: image of relevant illustration of the subject; if available, also use more specific properties (sample: coat of arms image, locator map, flag image, signature image, logo image, collage image)

P19.label: place of birth
P19.description: most specific known birth location of a person, animal or fictional character

P20.label: place of death
P20.description: most specific known (e.g. city instead of country, or hospital instead of city) death location of a person, animal or fictional character

P21.label: sex or gender
P21.description: sex or gender identity of human or animal. For human: male, female, non-binary, intersex, transgender female, transgender male, agender, etc. For animal: male organism, female organism. Groups of same gender use subclass of (P279)

P27.label: country of citizenship
P27.description: the object is a country that recognizes the subject as its citizen

P30.label: continent
P30.description: continent of which the subject is a part

P31.label: instance of
P31.description: type to which this subject corresponds/belongs. Different from P279 (subclass of); for example: K2 is an instance of mountain; volcano is a subclass of mountain

P39.label: position held
P39.description: subject currently or formerly holds the object position or public office

P47.label: shares border with
P47.description: countries or administrative subdivisions, of equal level, that this item borders, either by land or water. A single common point is enough.

P50.label: author
P50.description: main creator(s) of a written work (use on works, not humans); use P2093 (author name string) when Wikidata item is unknown or does not exist

P53.label: family
P53.description: family, including dynasty and nobility houses. Not family name (use P734 for family name).

P61.label: discoverer or inventor
P61.description: subject who discovered, first described, invented, or developed this discovery or invention or scientific hypothesis or theory

P88.label: commissioned by
P88.description: person or organization that commissioned this work

P94.label: coat of arms image
P94.description: image of the item's coat of arms - for the shield part only use P4004

P101.label: field of work
P101.description: specialization of a person or organization; see P106 for the occupation/ P452 for industry

P102.label: member of political party
P102.description: the political party of which a person is or has been a member or otherwise affiliated

P106.label: occupation
P106.description: occupation of a person. See also "field of work" (Property:P101), "position held" (Property:P39). Not for groups of people. There, use "field of work" (Property:P101), "industry" (Property:P452), "members have occupation" (Property:P3989).

P108.label: employer
P108.description: person or organization for which the subject works or worked

P112.label: founder
P112.description: founder or co-founder of this organization, religion, place or entity

P131.label: located in the administrative territorial entity
P131.description: the item is located on the territory of the following administrative entity. Use P276 for specifying locations that are non-administrative places and for items about events. Use P1382 if the item falls only partially into the administrative entity

P135.label: movement
P135.description: literary, artistic, scientific or philosophical movement or scene associated with this person or work. For political ideologies use P1142.

P136.label: genre
P136.description: creative work's genre or an artist's field of work (P101). Use main subject (P921) to relate creative works to their topic

P137.label: operator
P137.description: person, profession, organization or entity that operates the equipment, facility, or service

P138.label: named after
P138.description: entity or event that inspired the subject's name, or namesake (in at least one language). Qualifier "applies to name" (P5168) can be used to indicate which one

P140.label: religion or worldview
P140.description: religion of a person, organization or religious building, or associated with this subject

P141.label: IUCN conservation status
P141.description: conservation status assigned by the International Union for Conservation of Nature

P144.label: based on
P144.description: the work(s) or inputs used as the basis for subject item; for fictional analog use P1074

P156.label: followed by
P156.description: immediately following item in a series of which the subject is a part, preferably use as qualifier of P179 [if the subject has been replaced, e.g. political offices, use "replaced by" (P1366)]

P159.label: headquarters location
P159.description: city or town where an organization's headquarters is or has been situated. Use P276 qualifier for specific building

P166.label: award received
P166.description: award or recognition received by a person, organization or creative work

P170.label: creator
P170.description: maker of this creative work or other object (where no more specific property exists)

P171.label: parent taxon
P171.description: closest parent taxon of the taxon in question

P172.label: ethnic group
P172.description: subject's ethnicity (consensus is that a VERY high standard of proof is needed for this field to be used. In general this means 1) the subject claims it themselves, or 2) it is widely agreed on by scholars, or 3) is fictional and portrayed as such)

P180.label: depicts
P180.description: entity visually depicted in an image, literarily described in a work, or otherwise incorporated into an audiovisual or other medium; see also P921, 'main subject'

P184.label: doctoral advisor
P184.description: person who supervised the doctorate or PhD thesis of the subject

P186.label: made from material
P186.description: material the subject or the object is made of or derived from (do not confuse with P10672 which is used for processes)

P189.label: location of discovery
P189.description: where the item was located when discovered

P190.label: twinned administrative body
P190.description: twin towns, sister cities, twinned municipalities and other localities that have a partnership or cooperative agreement, either legally or informally acknowledged by their governments

P195.label: collection
P195.description: art, museum, archival, or bibliographic collection of which the subject is part (item is in the collection of X)

P214.label: VIAF cluster ID
P214.description: identifier for the Virtual International Authority File database [format: up to 22 digits]; please note: VIAF is a cluster, the ID can include multiple items

P217.label: inventory number
P217.description: identifier for a physical object or a set of physical objects in a collection

P218.label: ISO 639-1 code
P218.description: 2-letter identifier for language or family of languages defined in ISO 639-1 standard

P225.label: taxon name
P225.description: correct scientific name of a taxon (according to the reference given)

P242.label: locator map image
P242.description: geographic map image which highlights the location of the subject within some larger entity

P245.label: Union List of Artist Names ID
P245.description: identifier from the Getty Union List of Artist Names

P272.label: production company
P272.description: company that produced this film, audio or performing arts work

P275.label: copyright license
P275.description: license under which this copyrighted work is released

P276.label: location
P276.description: location of the object, structure or event; use P131 to indicate the containing administrative entity, P8138 for statistical entities, or P706 for geographic entities; use P7153 for locations associated with the object

P279.label: subclass of
P279.description: this item is a subclass (subset) of that item; ALL instances of this item are instances of that item; different from P31 (instance of), e.g.: volcano is a subclass of mountain; Everest is an instance of mountain

P298.label: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code
P298.description: identifier for a country in three-letter format per ISO 3166-1

P304.label: page(s)
P304.description: page number of source referenced for statement. Note "column(s)" (P3903) and "folio(s)" (P7416) for other numbering systems

P305.label: IETF language tag
P305.description: identifier for language or languoid per the Internet Engineering Task Force; can include a primary language subtag, subtags for script, region, variant, extension, or private-use. Format: 2 or 3 letters, followed by "-" if subtags present

P345.label: IMDb ID
P345.description: identifier for the IMDb (with prefix 'tt', 'nm', 'co', 'ev', 'ch' or 'ni')

P361.label: part of
P361.description: object of which the subject is a part (as directly as possible); inverse property of "has part" (P527, see also "has parts of the class" (P2670))

P364.label: original language of film or TV show
P364.description: language in which a film or a performance work was originally created. Deprecated for written works and songs; use P407 ("language of work or name") instead.

P373.label: Commons category
P373.description: name of the Wikimedia Commons category containing files related to this item (without the prefix "Category:")

P393.label: edition number
P393.description: number of an edition (first, second, ... as 1, 2, ...) or event

P397.label: parent astronomical body
P397.description: major astronomical body the item belongs to

P405.label: taxon author
P405.description: the author(s) that (optionally) may be cited with the scientific name

P407.label: language of work or name
P407.description: language associated with this creative work (such as books, shows, songs, broadcasts or websites) or a name (for persons use "native language" (P103) and "languages spoken, written or signed" (P1412))

P424.label: Wikimedia language code
P424.description: identifier for a language or variant as used by Wikimedia projects

P428.label: botanist author abbreviation
P428.description: standard form (official abbreviation) of a personal name for use in an author citation (only for names of algae, fungi and plants)

P449.label: original broadcaster
P449.description: network(s) or service(s) that originally broadcast a radio or television program

P463.label: member of
P463.description: organization, club or musical group to which the subject belongs. Do not use for membership in ethnic or social groups, nor for holding a political position, such as a member of parliament (use P39 for that)

P485.label: archives at
P485.description: the institution holding the subject's archives

P495.label: country of origin
P495.description: country of origin of this item (creative work, food, phrase, product, etc.)

P497.label: CBDB ID
P497.description: identifier for a person in the China Biographical Database

P509.label: cause of death
P509.description: underlying or immediate cause of death. Underlying cause (e.g. car accident, stomach cancer) preferred. Use 'manner of death' (P1196) for broadest category, e.g. natural causes, accident, homicide, suicide

P518.label: applies to part
P518.description: part, aspect, or form of the item to which the claim applies

P528.label: catalog code
P528.description: catalog name of an object, use with qualifier P972

P547.label: commemorates
P547.description: what or whom is commemorated by the place, monument, memorial, or holiday

P551.label: residence
P551.description: the place where the person is or has been, resident

P569.label: date of birth
P569.description: date on which the subject was born

P570.label: date of death
P570.description: date on which the subject died

P571.label: inception
P571.description: time when an entity begins to exist; for date of official opening use P1619

P575.label: time of discovery or invention
P575.description: date or point in time when the item was discovered or invented

P576.label: dissolved, abolished or demolished
P576.description: point in time at which the subject (organisation, building) ceased to exist; see "date of official closure" (P3999) for closing a facility, "service retirement" (P730) for retiring equipment, "discontinued date" (P2669) for stopping a product

P577.label: publication date
P577.description: date or point in time when a work or product was first published or released

P580.label: start time
P580.description: time an entity begins to exist or a statement starts being valid

P582.label: end time
P582.description: moment when an entity ceases to exist and a statement stops being entirely valid or no longer be true

P585.label: point in time
P585.description: date something took place, existed or a statement was true; for providing time use the "refine date" property (P4241)

P607.label: participated in conflict
P607.description: battles, wars or other military engagements in which the person or item participated

P608.label: exhibition history
P608.description: exhibitions where the item is or was displayed

P611.label: religious order
P611.description: monastic or Sufi order to which an individual or religious institution belongs

P625.label: coordinate location
P625.description: geocoordinates of the subject. For Earth, please note that only the WGS84 geodetic datum is currently supported

P627.label: IUCN taxon ID
P627.description: identifier for a taxon in the International Union for Conservation of Nature database; source for conservation status (P141)

P629.label: version, edition or translation of
P629.description: is a version, edition or translation of this entity

P710.label: participant
P710.description: person, group of people or organization (object) that actively takes/took part in an event or process (subject). Preferably qualify with "object has role" (P3831). Use P1923 for participants that are teams.

P729.label: service entry
P729.description: date or point in time on which a piece or class of equipment entered operational service

P800.label: notable work
P800.description: notable scientific, artistic or literary work, or other work of significance among subject's works

P825.label: dedicated to
P825.description: person or organization to whom the subject was dedicated

P837.label: day in year for periodic occurrence
P837.description: when a specific holiday or periodic event occurs. It can be used as statement or qualifier

P854.label: reference URL
P854.description: should be used for Internet URLs as references. Use "Wikimedia import URL" (P4656) for imports from Wikimedia sites

P856.label: official website
P856.description: URL of the official page of an item (current or former). Usage: If a listed URL no longer points to the official website, do not remove it, but see the "Hijacked or dead websites" section of the Talk page

P921.label: main subject
P921.description: primary topic of a work or act of communication

P937.label: work location
P937.description: location where persons or organisations were actively participating in employment, business or other work

P941.label: inspired by
P941.description: work, human, place or event which inspired this creative work or fictional entity

P953.label: work available at URL
P953.description: URL of a web page containing this work

P973.label: described at URL
P973.description: item is described at the following URL

P1001.label: applies to jurisdiction
P1001.description: the item (institution, law, public office, public register, etc) or statement belongs to or has power over or applies to the value (a territorial jurisdiction: a country, state, municipality, etc)

P1026.label: academic thesis
P1026.description: thesis or dissertation written for a degree

P1071.label: location of creation
P1071.description: place where the item was conceived or made; where applicable, location of final assembly

P1080.label: from narrative universe
P1080.description: subject's fictional entity is in the object narrative. See also P1441 (present in work) and P1445 (fictional universe described in)

P1086.label: atomic number
P1086.description: number of protons found in the nucleus of the atom

P1104.label: number of pages
P1104.description: number of pages in an edition of a written work; see allowed units constraint for valid values to use for units in conjunction with a number

P1114.label: quantity
P1114.description: number of instances of this subject in the universe of the subject (the actual number of instances in Wikidata may be lower or higher)

P1216.label: National Heritage List for England number
P1216.description: number on the National Heritage List for England

P1225.label: U.S. National Archives Identifier
P1225.description: identifier for the United States National Archives and Records Administration's online catalog

P1303.label: instrument
P1303.description: musical instrument that a person plays or teaches or used in a music occupation

P1317.label: floruit
P1317.description: date when the person was known to be active or alive, when birth or death not documented

P1319.label: earliest date
P1319.description: earliest date at which an event could have happened. Use as qualifier for other date properties

P1326.label: latest date
P1326.description: latest possible time that something could have occurred. Use as qualifier for other date properties

P1343.label: described by source
P1343.description: work where this item is described, in statistical contexts, a methodological note describing the data

P1411.label: nominated for
P1411.description: award nomination received by a person, organisation or creative work (inspired from "award received" (Property:P166))

P1412.label: languages spoken, written or signed
P1412.description: language(s) that a person or a people speaks, writes or signs, including the native language(s)

P1415.label: Oxford Dictionary of National Biography ID
P1415.description: old identifier used by the Oxford Dictionary of National Biography, see discussion page for details

P1417.label: Encyclopædia Britannica Online ID
P1417.description: identifier for an article in the online version of Encyclopædia Britannica

P1433.label: published in
P1433.description: larger work that a given work was published in, like a journal, a website, a collection, a book or a music album

P1435.label: heritage designation
P1435.description: heritage designation of a cultural or natural site

P1436.label: collection or exhibition size
P1436.description: number of items in a collection or exhibition

P1441.label: present in work
P1441.description: this (fictional or fictionalized) entity, place, or person appears in that work as part of the narration (use P2860 for works citing other works, P361/P1433 for works being part of other works, P1343 for entities described in non-fictional accounts)

P1476.label: title
P1476.description: published name of a work, such as a newspaper article, a literary work, piece of music, a website, or a performance work

P1545.label: series ordinal
P1545.description: position of an item in its parent series (most frequently a 1-based index), generally to be used as a qualifier (different from "rank" defined as a class, and from "ranking" defined as a property for evaluating a quality)

P1552.label: has characteristic
P1552.description: inherent or distinguishing quality or feature of the entity. Use a more specific property when possible

P1559.label: name in native language
P1559.description: name of a person in their native language

P1566.label: GeoNames ID
P1566.description: identifier in the GeoNames geographical database

P1574.label: exemplar of
P1574.description: links an individual copy of a work to the item for that work or edition

P1614.label: History of Parliament ID
P1614.description: identifier on the History of Parliament website

P1679.label: Art UK artwork ID
P1679.description: identifier for artworks (publicly owned oil paintings and sculptures in the UK)

P1686.label: for work
P1686.description: qualifier of award received (P166) to specify the work that an award was given to the creator for

P1774.label: workshop of
P1774.description: artist whose work group are the likely creator of an artwork

P1802.label: Early Modern Letters Online person ID
P1802.description: identifier in the Early Modern Letters Online project run by the Bodleian Library

P1816.label: National Portrait Gallery (London) person ID
P1816.description: identifier for sitters and artists represented in the National Portrait Gallery, London

P1817.label: addressee
P1817.description: person or organization to whom a letter or note is addressed

P1819.label: genealogics.org person ID
P1819.description: identifier for a person at genealogics.org. Format: "I" followed by 8 digits

P1843.label: taxon common name
P1843.description: common or vernacular name of a biological taxon

P1922.label: first line
P1922.description: first line (incipit) of a poem, first sentence of a novel, speech, etc.

P1936.label: Digital Atlas of the Roman Empire ID
P1936.description: Identifier of a Roman site, in the Digital Atlas of the Roman Empire

P2002.label: X username
P2002.description: username on X (formerly Twitter); do not include the '@' symbol

P2013.label: Facebook username
P2013.description: identifier for an official (preferably) Facebook person, product or organization page (everything that follows URL part 'https://www.facebook.com/')

P2093.label: author name string
P2093.description: stores unspecified author or editor name for publications; use if Wikidata item for author (P50) or editor (P98) does not exist or is not known. Do not use both.

P2348.label: time period
P2348.description: time period (historic period or era, sports season, theatre season, legislative period etc.) in which the subject occurred or with which it is associated

P2386.label: diameter
P2386.description: diameter of a circular or spherical object

P2474.label: CDLI ID
P2474.description: unique identifier of an object in the Cuneiform Digital Library Initiative

P2520.label: UNESCO Biosphere Reserve URL
P2520.description: URL to the entry on the UNESCO biosphere reserve website

P2596.label: culture
P2596.description: human culture or people (or several cultures) associated with this item

P2843.label: Benezit ID
P2843.description: identifier in Benezit Dictionary of Artists

P2868.label: subject has role
P2868.description: role held by the item the statement appears on ("subject") in the context of that statement. For the role of the statement object/value, use P3831 ("object has role"). For acting roles, use P453 ("character role"). For persons, use P39.

P3029.label: UK National Archives ID
P3029.description: identifier for a person, family or organisation, in the UK's National Archives database

P3274.label: content deliverer
P3274.description: third party service (e.g. Google Books, Internet Archive, etc.) that made the content available where it was accessed

P3311.label: image of design plans
P3311.description: image representing the plan of a building or place

P3429.label: Electronic Enlightenment ID
P3429.description: identifier in the Electronic Enlightenment database

P3444.label: eBird taxon ID
P3444.description: identifier for a species or subspecies, in the eBird database

P3939.label: English Short Title Catalogue ID
P3939.description: identifier in the English Short Title Catalogue

P4033.label: Mastodon address
P4033.description: address on the Mastodon decentralized social network (the form is 'user@server.domain' without a leading '@')

P4101.label: thesis submitted to
P4101.description: institution to whom a thesis or dissertation is submitted

P4102.label: Atlas of Hillforts ID
P4102.description: identifier in the Atlas of Hillforts database

P4353.label: nominated by
P4353.description: who nominated a person for an office or award; can be used as a qualifier

P4431.label: Google Doodle
P4431.description: Google Doodle celebrating this entity or event

P4438.label: BFI Films, TV and people ID (archived)
P4438.description: identifier for a person or movie at BFI Film & TV Database. Format: 13 digits and lowercase letters

P4629.label: Online Books Page author ID
P4629.description: identifier for an author, at the Online Books Page website

P4672.label: Early Modern Letters Online location ID
P4672.description: identifier for a location in the Early Modern Letters Online database maintained by the University of Oxford

P4841.label: total fertility rate
P4841.description: average number of children that would be born to a woman over her lifetime who lives in this territorial entity

P4896.label: 3D model
P4896.description: representation of any three-dimensional surface of an object

P5008.label: on focus list of Wikimedia project
P5008.description: property to indicate that an item is of particular interest for a Wikimedia project. This property does not add notability. Items should not be created with this property if they are not notable for Wikidata. See also P6104, P972, P2354

P6108.label: IIIF manifest URL
P6108.description: JSON-LD formatted document URL reference described by the IIIF Presentation API

P6193.label: ratified by
P6193.description: used to specify that a treaty has been ratified by a given state or subject of international law

P6216.label: copyright status
P6216.description: copyright status for intellectual creations like works of art, publications, software, etc.

P6610.label: Ashmolean Museum ID
P6610.description: number of the object on online collections

P6698.label: Japan Search name ID
P6698.description: identifier in the Japan Search portal

P6802.label: related image
P6802.description: less fitting image, used only because a better alternative is not available. If an appropriate image of the item is available, use P18 instead. Value should not be a generic placeholder

P8345.label: media franchise
P8345.description: this creative work belongs to this media franchise

P8406.label: Grove Art Online ID
P8406.description: identifier of a topic in Grove Art Online

P9302.label: script style
P9302.description: style of script of a document or typeface

Q79.description: country in Northeast Africa and Southwest Asia

Q83.description: free and open-source wiki software, developed by the Wikimedia Foundation

Q7378.description: large terrestrial mammals from Africa and Asia
